input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser splits the uploaded text using `text.split("
")`, which does not account for Windows-style `
` line endings. When the new accounting export tool (running on Windows) produces CRLF line endings, each line retains a trailing ``, which gets appended to the last column of every row (including the header on row 1). This causes the column count/content mismatch and triggers `errors.rowShape` ("Malformed row") on row 1 even though the file looks fine in a spreadsheet. The fix should normalize line endings (e.g., strip `` or split on `/
||
/`) before parsing.

text: The file is confirmed: `src/ingest/parser.ts` splits on `"\n"` only, so Windows-exported files with `\r\n` line endings leave a trailing `\r` on each field, causing column mismatches (and row 1, the header itself, mismatching due to the `\r` being appended to the last header column).
